digest.component_or_area: bridge pause/resume surface and gate format
propositions: Pause/resume surface must preserve dual-format gate blob with gated_mode and pause metadata while remaining readable by old decoders
Pause operation must block before lock acquisition or ticket mutation and emit exact anchored JSON BRIDGE_PAUSED marker on rc 0
Resume must perform observed-OID CAS and safely clear absent, valid, or corrupt state without decoding the blob
Same-reason pause must be idempotent and preserve metadata; different-reason, blank-reason, missing-identity, missing-remote, and CAS-conflict pauses must refuse without overwrite
Pause provenance must capture repository git user.email and first-pause UTC RFC3339 timestamp

Scheduled workflow must recognize only complete rc-0 BRIDGE_PAUSED marker and skip commit-and-push; corrupt blobs must return clean rc 1 with recovery line; legacy gate rc 4 and old reconcile vocabulary must remain functional
